description: Bumps the digest of the Debian base in dockerfile and the SHA-pinned actions in the publish workflow. A green pull request merges itself; see README.md.

packageRules.description: A major never merges itself. A Debian major is a toolchain move, and a GitHub Action's major is where its inputs change, which a pull request cannot exercise for the login, push and notify steps that run only on main. Renovate assigns the pull request to the maintainer when it opens.
The Debian base is named by its tag and pinned by digest, so a refreshed trixie-slim is a digest update that rebuilds the image on it.
